Stating Goals in German: B1 Phrase Practice

Explain a goal, intention and purpose in German. Practise Ziel, vorhaben, um zu and damit with translated examples and explained B1 answers.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions + writing task

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Try the exercisesWrite your own sentence

Useful phrases and patterns

Mein Ziel ist es, … zu … states an objective. Ich habe vor, … zu … describes an intention. Um … zu … explains a purpose when the understood subject remains the same. Damit can introduce a purpose with its own subject. A goal describes the outcome being sought rather than proving it will occur.

Common mistake to avoid

Keep the infinitive structure after habe vor: Ich habe vor, regelmäßig zu üben. Damit uses a subordinate clause with a conjugated verb at the end.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Notice what the speaker wants to do, the level of politeness and the details the listener needs.

Worked example 1Mein Ziel ist es, freier vor einer Gruppe zu sprechen.My goal is to speak more freely in front of a group.
Worked example 2Ich habe vor, jede Woche einen kurzen Text zu verfassen.I intend to write a short text every week.
Worked example 3Ich übe die Einleitung, um sicherer aufzutreten.I practise the introduction in order to present more confidently.
Worked example 4Wir sammeln Beispiele, damit alle den Ablauf verstehen.We collect examples so that everyone understands the process.

Practice: complete the phrases

Complete the goal or purpose phrase using the noun, verb particle or connector specified by the cue. Use each word-bank item once. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: damit · um · vor · Ziel

Question 1. Mein ___ ist es, deutlicher zu formulieren. (goal)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: Ziel

Ziel identifies the desired outcome.

Question 2. Ich habe ___, den Vortrag vorher zu üben. (in the intention expression)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: vor

Habe vor introduces an intention with a zu-infinitive.

Question 3. Ich lese den Text laut, ___ die Aussprache zu üben. (in order)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: um

Um introduces the purpose infinitive with the same understood subject.

Question 4. Wir erklären die Begriffe, ___ die Zuhörer folgen können. (so that)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: damit

Damit introduces the purpose clause with its own subject.

Use it in your own sentence

State a speaking goal and one concrete practice action.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Ich möchte freier sprechen und übe deshalb jeden Tag eine kurze Vorstellung.

Check your wording: Connect the goal to an observable activity instead of only naming an aspiration.

What to practise next

Adapt a model to a different listener or situation. Keep the request, time reference and formal or informal address consistent.

Try the gaps again on another day without reading the explanation first. If a choice is still unclear, use the linked grammar foundation before moving to another topic.
